synthetic_data_notice: All generated datasets and evaluations in this report use synthetic agent session simulations. Results measure evaluation methodology sensitivity (label leakage, template cloning, and row-level vs scenario-grouped splitting) and must NOT be interpreted as real-world attack detection effectiveness.

evaluation.disclaimer: All sessions in this benchmark are synthetically generated for controlled evaluation methodology analysis and do NOT represent real-world production security effectiveness.

indirect_total_events_leakage_analysis.explanation: In raw 'total_events', SECURITY_ANALYSIS, SECURITY_DETECTION, and BEHAVIORAL_ANOMALY events are counted in the session length. 'non_security_total_events' strips these detector-generated events so session length reflects only operational user/tool/agent events.

cv_metrics.coverage_note: Requested 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold cannot place SUSPICIOUS sessions in all 5 validation folds because dataset has 6 NORMAL families and 3 SUSPICIOUS families. Automatically used 3-fold StratifiedGroupKFold (max folds with full two-class coverage).
